requirements.statement: Target-model weight storage shall have no functional write path after manufacture; test and repair controls shall not alter logical weight values.
Every accepted inference command shall be bound to the mask-programmed 256-bit image identity and compatible ABI major version.
The architecture shall execute ordered single-token autoregressive decode over the stage-owned contiguous layer interval and return exactly one completion or error per accepted command.
The architecture shall support target verification for 1 through 15 speculative candidates and shall charge draft traffic and work separately from target verification.
The primary proof configuration shall represent pinned DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with 43 layers, 256 experts, top-6 routing, 4096 hidden size, and two midpoint stages.
The stretch configuration shall represent pinned DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 with 61 layers, 384 experts, top-6 routing, 7168 hidden size, and six midpoint stages.
The stress configuration shall represent pinned Kimi-K3 with 93 layers, 896 experts, top-16 routing, 7168 hidden size, and eleven midpoint stages without being promoted to a product target.

The command and session model shall represent 200000- and 1000000-token DeepSeek/Kimi contexts and the 8192-token Qwen3-8B control context, plus mandatory batch-per-stage points 1, 8, and 64, without encoding model-specific constants in datapath logic.
Commands within one session shall retire in position order; data, errors, and completions shall not cross session or epoch boundaries.
A pipeline of S stages shall reserve S times the batch-per-stage resident sessions and shall reject admission before mutating state when local stage capacity is insufficient.
QUIESCE shall stop new admission and drain accepted work; ABORT shall produce an ordered terminal response and prevent further architectural state updates for the transaction.
Unsupported opcodes, fields, versions, schedules, image identities, and reserved-bit values shall be rejected without partial execution and with a classified response.

The dense-control configuration shall represent pinned Qwen3-8B with 36 layers, 4096 hidden size, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, BF16 storage, an untied output head, one midpoint stage, and an 8192-token study context without an implicit speculative draft.
The product hypothesis shall budget 100 TB/s exposed ROM read bandwidth per stage before separately declared efficiency, repair, clock, and synchronization derates.
The product hypothesis shall budget 1 POP/s routed low-precision and 0.5 POP/s dense higher-precision peak arithmetic per stage before derates.
The product hypothesis shall budget 8 TB/s bidirectional HBM payload bandwidth per stage and shall account for weight-independent KV reads and writes.
The NoC contract shall expose a 100 ns per-layer fixed floor plus payload serialization at 128 GB/s before the independent synchronization derate.
The cross-stage contract shall budget 128 GB/s payload bandwidth and 0.5 microsecond one-way fixed latency per boundary before retries.
The digital implementation shall count accepted commands, active cycles, stalls by cause, ROM/HBM/NoC service, retries, throttling, and latency histograms without changing functional results.
No analytical peak, open-PDK proxy, or synthetic trace shall be labeled as measured product throughput, power, area, latency, or GPU superiority.
Each product-hypothesis stage shall expose 160 GB usable immutable weight capacity after a separately visible raw-capacity repair/layout reserve.
Each product-hypothesis stage shall expose 384 GB physical HBM with at most 90 percent available to checkpoint-adjacent state and KV after runtime reserve.
ROM and HBM legality shall be checked per physical stage and per contiguous layer partition; capacity shall not be pooled across stages.
Architectural encodings shall support up to 16 stages, 128 layers, 1024 experts, top-16 routing, 2^24 sessions, and 1048576 context tokens.
The compiler shall reject an image or schedule exceeding any local ROM, HBM, identifier, table, buffer, or schedule-epoch bound before it can be activated.
Every routed expert matrix shall be striped across the service tile population so data-dependent routing changes local wordline masks, not physical NoC routes.
Activation broadcast and partial-sum reduction shall use compile-time schedules with no dynamic route or arbitration decision in the service datapath.
Two schedule banks shall support checked shadow loading and atomic epoch-boundary activation only while the affected traffic class is quiescent.
Transaction-level sink credit shall be reserved before launch; an admitted static-NoC packet shall never wait for link-level ready and shall be delivered or poison-aborted exactly once.
Schedule activation shall require machine-checked output-conflict freedom, source legality, route termination, sequence continuity, and buffer occupancy within the frozen bound.
For a fixed image, schedule, repair map, command stream, and error-free initial state, NoC delivery and reduction order shall be cycle deterministic.
Permanent tile or link faults shall be handled by offline quarantine and a revalidated schedule; dynamic best-effort detours are prohibited in deterministic service mode.
The host command and response interfaces shall implement the exact ready/valid widths, fields, CRCs, status codes, and ordering in interfaces.json.
The CSR interface and address map shall implement interfaces.json, including write-one-to-clear errors, first-error capture, image identity, and protected schedule/repair windows.
The public HBM abstraction shall implement tagged requests and responses, in-order beats within a tag, declared error status, and no assumption about licensed PHY timing.
The stage-link abstraction shall preserve NoC flit content, add packet CRC32C, use packet credits, and retry at most twice before deterministic abort.
Fatal and uncorrectable telemetry shall be lossless until acknowledged; correctable informational events may be counted and coalesced without losing first-error evidence.

A producer shall hold valid payload stable while stalled on any ready/valid interface, and no combinational path shall run from a downstream ready input to an upstream valid output across a module boundary.
Reserved command and register bits shall read as zero and be written as zero; incompatible ABI major versions shall be rejected and minor versions shall preserve prior field meanings.

The target numerical profile shall support packed MXFP4 E2M1 routed weights with E8M0 block scales, FP8 E4M3FN dense weights, BF16 architectural activations, and FP32 partial accumulation as normatively encoded.
Conversions and architectural results shall use round-to-nearest ties-to-even, defined saturation/NaN rules, and the fixed ascending lane/tile reduction order.
Reserved E8M0, malformed packed data, detected ROM corruption, and unsupported numeric modes shall poison and abort the affected transaction rather than silently substitute a value.
An integer-surrogate DV mode may reduce public-tool cost but shall use a distinct mode ID and shall not count as target-format numerical closure.
The image compiler shall canonicalize checkpoint-specific tensor order and nibble packing into the internal layout before mask data and expected signatures are emitted.
Backpressure, repaired routing, and legal clock throttling shall not change numerical ordering or bits for an error-free transaction.
Host, CSR, NoC, tile, and telemetry records shall use CRC16-CCITT with the frozen initialization, reflection, and coverage rules; stage packets shall additionally use CRC32C.
Architectural SRAM and FIFO storage shall use SECDED per 64 data bits or an equally strong documented code, correct single-bit errors, and poison on detected uncorrectable errors.
ROM content shall be checked by per-block CRC32C during service and by full-address signature/BIST before enable; a mismatch shall prevent or abort inference.
A detected uncorrectable data-path error shall contain updates to the affected transaction, propagate poison, emit one terminal error, and leave unrelated sessions serviceable when isolation permits.
Programmable watchdogs shall detect bounded command, NoC, HBM, link, BIST, and quiesce timeouts and transition through abort to SAFE when recovery fails.
ROM row/column remaps and tile/link quarantine maps shall be range checked, CRC protected, immutable while active, and reflected in image/schedule compatibility checks.
The complete SHA-256 image identity and active schedule/repair epoch shall be software readable and included in diagnostic capture.
First-error state shall be sticky until explicit clear and shall capture severity, source, epoch, transaction, timestamp, and syndrome without being overwritten by later errors.
The system shall expose degraded capacity, bandwidth, disabled resources, and repair exhaustion; it shall never present nominal capacity after repair makes it unavailable.
Diagnostics shall provide non-destructive heartbeat, counter, loopback, BIST signature, repair-map, and error-log access without exposing a weight-write mechanism.
The design shall implement distinct always-on configuration, core, HBM, stage-link, and test clock domains with only inventoried crossings.
Power-on reset shall assert asynchronously and deassert synchronously in every domain; warm reset shall quiesce or terminally abort in-flight work before architectural state is cleared.
The architectural power FSM shall implement OFF, STANDBY, IDLE, ACTIVE, THROTTLED, and SAFE with legal transition guards, isolation, and visible state.
Clock throttling shall preserve protocol and numerical behavior; an over-limit or invalid sensor condition shall quiesce, abort if required, and enter SAFE.
Multi-bit asynchronous traffic shall cross through asynchronous FIFOs or closed-loop handshakes; single-bit status shall use qualified synchronizers and reconvergence shall be reviewed.
Clock gating shall use integrated-gate semantics with test override and no data-dependent glitch; the public reference shall not infer unmodeled power-gated retention behavior.
Every scannable digital sequential element shall belong to a declared scan domain or an individually justified exclusion; clock and reset controls shall support safe shift and capture.
ROM, SRAM/FIFO, NoC links, and stage links shall have independently invocable BIST with bounded completion, signatures, fault status, and diagnostic localization.

The product boundary shall reserve IEEE 1149.1-compatible JTAG and IEEE 1687-compatible instrument access; the public proxy shall model their register-level behavior without claiming licensed insertion closure.

Target-node signoff goals shall be at least 99 percent stuck-at and 95 percent transition fault coverage after reviewed exclusions; public tools shall report this as an external gap when ATPG cannot establish it.
Inference enable shall remain blocked until mandatory boot BIST and repair loading complete successfully; test mode shall force inference interfaces inactive.

Given identical pinned checkpoint metadata, compiler version, parameters, and defect map, the image compiler shall emit byte-identical manifests, canonical layouts, schedules, and expected signatures.
The manifest shall bind source revision, tensor inventory hashes, numeric profile, layer partition, ROM regions, schedules, repair compatibility, ABI, tool version, and SHA-256 image identity.
The schedule compiler shall emit a proof certificate covering route endpoints, output conflicts, per-slot sources, sequence continuity, maximum occupancy, quarantined resources, and schedule CRC.
A repair map shall include device identity, monotonic generation, resource remaps, quarantine set, capacity impact, CRC, and compatibility hash before activation.

Boot shall sequence identity discovery, clock/reset qualification, defect-map load, schedule validation, memory/link/ROM BIST, capacity publication, and queue enable, failing closed into diagnostic SAFE.
Firmware and host software shall negotiate ABI major/minor, discover capabilities and degraded resources, and preserve deterministic command semantics across compatible minor revisions.
No host, debug, test, repair, or firmware transaction shall provide an architectural path to modify logical mask-ROM contents.
Public artifacts shall use SHA-256 for identity and integrity binding; authenticity and secure-boot roots are external macros and shall not be claimed by an unsigned public manifest.
The public-reference interface assumes a trusted host and does not claim tenant confidentiality, side-channel resistance, secure key storage, or hostile DMA isolation.
Diagnostic access shall expose signatures, syndromes, counters, and repair metadata but shall not expose arbitrary resident session payloads through the normal CSR space.
The public RTL shall be parameterized and shall elaborate legal reduced DV configurations and architectural maxima where resource limits permit, with compile-time rejection of illegal combinations.
Each implementation block shall be preceded by a requirement allocation, interface contract, reference model, assertions, and planned verification entry.
ROM, SRAM, HBM, PLL, PHY, sensor, eFuse/OTP, security-root, and scan-compression dependencies shall be isolated behind behavioral wrappers with explicit timing, integrity, reset, and error contracts.
Synthesizable RTL shall contain no unexplained latch, combinational loop, undriven net, multiply driven net, width/sign truncation, or simulation/synthesis semantic divergence.
Builds and regressions shall capture tool versions, parameters, seeds, commands, input hashes, logs, and failure artifacts and shall not depend on NDA or non-redistributable PDK collateral.
Every must-have requirement shall trace to architecture allocation, implementation allocation, and at least one planned check, then to passing evidence before verification closure.

RTL shall pass at least two independent parser/lint frontends and two simulators; tractable control and protocol blocks shall have formal safety and non-vacuous cover checks with two solver configurations.
Directed, constrained-random, differential, reset, backpressure, malformed-input, long-running, parameter, and numerical-corner tests shall compare against executable reference models.
The verification campaign shall inject every planned transient and permanent fault class and demonstrate detection, correction, containment, retry, degradation, or safe terminal failure as specified.

Verification closure shall meet 95 percent line, 90 percent branch, 85 percent toggle, 100 percent must-bin functional, 100 percent planned formal, and 100 percent requirement-evidence targets or carry individually owned reviewed exclusions.

Implementation synthesis shall begin only after zero open severity-1/2 bugs, zero unexplained static errors, passing regressions and proofs, reviewed CDC/RDC, closed must bins, and an owned waiver ledger for the frozen RTL baseline.
Every quantitative or factual claim shall retain one of measured, published, derived, assumed, simulated, or synthetic evidence classes and shall name the replacement evidence needed for product use.
